engine.win_condition: Generate infinite death triggers, creature ETBs, and recursion through Karmic Guide + Reveillark/Saffi Eriksdotter + a sacrifice outlet (Viscera Seer or Altar of Dementia), enabling infinite mill, card draw, or creature recursion to win.
Attack with creatures to trigger Isperia's card draw, protect creatures with lifegain and planeswalker support, then close with combat damage or overwhelming board presence.

Deploy Birds, amplify them with +1/+1 counters and anthem effects triggered by combat damage, then deal commander damage or create overwhelming aerial advantage through Kastral's recurring recursion triggers.

Build a board of Vehicles and artifact tokens, crew Vehicles to attack, while generating card advantage through Shorikai's looting and artifact synergies. The Intruder Alarm combo provides an alternate infinite-looting line but is secondary to the vehicle-focused gameplan.
Attack with Rafiq or a single evasive creature pumped by exalted triggers and double strike, closing quickly through commander damage or focused creature damage.

Chain blink effects via Roon and Deadeye Navigator to repeatedly trigger creature ETB abilities and landfall triggers, generating card advantage and mana advantage until overwhelming the board. Non-winning combo lines (Deadeye Navigator loops) provide mana acceleration but are not the primary win path.

Chain enchantments for card draw via Tuvasa's draw trigger and enchantress payoff effects, build Tuvasa into a commander-damage threat through enchantment pump, then close via commander damage or enchantment-generated board presence.

Trigger Nelly's attack to goad enemy creatures and generate card draw from opponent combat damage, while building a controlling board with pillowfort effects. Close through direct combat or attrition.

Generate tokens repeatedly, attack with them to trigger Neyali's double-strike and card advantage, then close via exponential token damage and card generation from attacking with many evasive creatures.
Equip Wyleth with Auras and Equipment to pump it, attack to generate card draw from attached permanents, then close via commander damage or overwhelming attacks.

Chain infinite sacrifice loops using Mikaeus the Unhallowed + Plague Belcher + Carrion Feeder, or Gravecrawler + Rooftop Storm + Phyrexian Altar to generate infinite creature ETBs, death triggers, and mana, then drain opponents or close via a payoff creature.
Chain enchantment permanents with Archon of Sun's Grace + Enchanted Evening or Ondu Spiritdancer + Secret Arcade to create infinite creature tokens, then win via token combat or draw the game.
Attack with Raffine to trigger connive, drawing and discarding cards for value and graveyard setup, then win through reanimation payoffs or overwhelming board presence with +1/+1 counters.
Use Sen Triplets to lock down opponents, revealing and playing their cards while restricting their actions. Win through control and eventual resource superiority or commander damage.
Animate noncreature artifacts with Sydri and grant them deathtouch and lifelink, then win through creature combat, sacrifice synergies, or artifact payoffs.
Cast Dragons to trigger The Ur-Dragon's cost reduction and draw triggers on attack, ramp into bigger Dragons and permanents, then win through Dragon combat damage.
Chain sacrifice and recursion with Marchesa's dethrone counters and cheat-death trigger, using Goblin Bombardment and other sac outlets to generate infinite loops or exponential damage.

Force massive draw via Peer into the Abyss and wheel effects, triggering Nekusar's damage on every draw, then finish with payoff cards like Psychosis Crawler, Underworld Dreams, or Sheoldred the Apocalypse.
Cast and transform Werewolves to trigger Tovolar's draw and power-pump ability, attack for combat damage while building card advantage.
Chain draw effects with The Locust God to create hasty Insect tokens, either going infinite with Sage of the Falls or using tokens for sacrifice payoffs and drain.
Chain noncreature spells to generate Spirit tokens via Kykar, then sacrifice them for value (mana, card draw, or drain triggers) while maintaining a growing board.

Build a planeswalker-heavy value engine with Narset attacking to generate free spells, leveraging Teferi, Master of Time infinite-turn combo as an alternate win condition via Ichormoon Gauntlet or The Chain Veil.

Chain spells to trigger Shiko's copy ability, generating cascading spell triggers that power magecraft payoffs. Magecraft combos like Expansion // Explosion with Narset's Reversal enable infinite loops to close.
Cast large creatures at a discount via blitz, draw cards on their death, then sacrifice them for additional value triggers and incremental advantage.
Return lands from graveyard via Lord Windgrace's recursion, triggering landfall payoffs repeatedly while generating removal tokens and grinding toward victory through value accumulation.
Deploy creatures with attack-triggered abilities, then double those triggers via Isshin to generate exponential value—card draw, mana, or damage—until opponents are overwhelmed.
Loop Gravecrawler + sacrifice outlet (Ashnod's Altar, Phyrexian Altar, or others) to generate infinite death triggers, dealing infinite damage via Ayara, Blood Artist, or Zulaport Cutthroat.
Reanimate creatures from graveyard via Sheoldred's upkeep ability while forcing opponents to sacrifice, then sacrifice those reanimated creatures for value triggers and card advantage.
Reanimate creatures from graveyard as Skeletons via Xu-Ifit, sacrifice them for value triggers (card draw or drain), then loop the cycle for incremental advantage.
Double mill effects via Bruvac's static ability, then chain mill payoffs like Fraying Sanity, Keening Stone, or Maddening Cacophony to mill opponents to zero library and trigger their deck-out loss.
Generate infinite artifact ETB and LTB cycles via Emry's graveyard casting, then win through infinite card draw, mana, or storm triggers.
Generate Drake tokens through Talrand's cast triggers while building card advantage through spells and control effects, then win through evasive token damage or card-based incremental advantage.

Chain landfall triggers via Azusa's extra land plays combined with recursion effects like Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra, generating infinite land tokens and mana to close via overwhelming board or damage.
Build Elf mana-producing creatures, then loop infinite card draw and mana via Staff of Domination paired with Elf generators, or close through combat with Ezuri's pump ability.
Build large creatures with +1/+1 counters while using Gargos's targeting triggers to fight down opposing creatures, then close through commander damage or overwhelming board presence.
Ramp through landfall triggers and mana production while Omnath accumulates unspent mana to pump itself, then close through commander damage with a massive Omnath.

Generate exponentially growing Goblin tokens via Krenko, loop them through sacrifice outlets like Skirk Prospector and enablers like Goblin Warchief for infinite red mana and creature generation to close the game.
Cast Dragons to generate flying token copies via Lathliss's ETB triggers, attack with evasive fliers for damage, supplemented by burn spells for incremental face damage.
Chain Angel ETBs to trigger soul-warden effects for recursive life gain, build board through Angel tribal synergy and repeating counters, then close via commander damage or life-drain payoffs.
Remove Marath's counters to create tokens and deal damage while looping infinite counters via Ivy Lane Denizen and Ashnod's Altar, generating lethal through infinite tokens or Cathars' Crusade.
Chain landfall triggers with Obuun to grow creatures and accumulate +1/+1 counters, then attack for commander or overwhelming board damage.
Chain lifegain triggers to grow Karlov via +1/+1 counters, while establishing win combos like Aetherflux Reservoir + Exquisite Blood for infinite damage or infinite loops.

Generate infinite mana and card draw via Derevi's tap/untap trigger on combat damage combined with Chromatic Orrery and Emiel the Blessed, or through Displacer Kitten loops with Sol Ring and Teferi for infinite storm, then win with overwhelming resources.

Fill graveyard with instant/sorcery spells; cast them repeatedly via Kess's graveyard casting ability combined with Underworld Breach, generating infinite draw, discard, and mill triggers for storm counts or oracle victory.

Execute targeted crimes (targeting opponents or their permanents) to trigger Marchesa's crime tutor, filling the graveyard and hand with resources. Win through overwhelming card advantage, reanimation, or combat via the churned value.

Reanimate Saga cards via Rydia's Summon ability, triggering landfall chains that create infinite land ETBs, creature tokens, and death triggers. Finish via infinite mana (Aftermath Analyst + Lotus Cobra), infinite creature LTB loops, or overwhelming board presence.

Chain instant and sorcery spells using Ral's cost reduction, triggering infinite spell copies via Reiterate or infinite draw/looting via Underworld Breach wheels. Build storm count or generate infinite mana/damage to finish.

Generate infinite 1/1 Spirit tokens via Kykar's cast trigger, then create infinite draw/mana loops using Displacer Kitten + mana rocks (Mox Amber/Opal/Sol Ring) + Teferi untap effects, or infinite draw via Underworld Breach wheels and mana payoffs.

Create infinite sacrifice loops via Chatterfang + Academy Manufactor (infinite artifact/Treasure/Food tokens), then sacrifice them for infinite mana, card draw, and death triggers. Finish via lifeloss effects (Zulaport Cutthroat, Blood Artist) or overwhelming resources.

Deal combat damage with evasive creatures to trigger Gonti's mill-and-exile ability, casting opponents' best cards while grinding them out through the theft loop.

Cast instant and sorcery spells from the graveyard via Kess and Underworld Breach, generating infinite storm and card advantage, then win via Tainted Pact+Thassa's Oracle, Demonic Consultation, or massive mill loops.

Convert life into black mana via K'rrik's phyrexian mana cost reduction and Bolas's Citadel, casting spells infinitely for draw or opponent mill, then win via Thassa's Oracle or Peer into the Abyss loops.

Chain enchantments for card advantage via Tuvasa's draw trigger and enchantress payoffs (Enchantress's Presence, Eidolon of Blossoms, Sigil of the Empty Throne), then win through Tuvasa commander damage or overwhelming board presence.
Generate infinite mana via artifact combos (Dramatic Reversal + Isochron Scepter; Power Artifact + Basalt/Grim Monolith; or Emry loops), then win through Urza's activated ability or Thassa's Oracle.

Cast instants and sorceries targeting Feather to exile and reuse them, building card advantage and eventually overwhelming opponents through repeated spell effects and damage payoffs.
Attack with non-Human creatures to cascade Winota's ability, tutoring Human creatures into play tapped and attacking. Build board presence through repeated cascades and close via combat damage.
Mill cards into your graveyard via Lazav's surveil and deck-tuning, then use Lazav's activation to copy powerful creatures from the graveyard and attack with evasive copies.
Chain mill payoffs via Duskmantle Guildmage, Mindcrank, Maddening Cacophony, and other mill doublers with Phenax's creature-toughness mill to mill all opponents out.

Attack with Ninjas to trigger Yuriko's damage and card draw. Use ninjutsu to redeploy Yuriko and cycle attackers, building damage pressure and card advantage to close the game.
Chain infinite planeswalker activations via Ichormoon Gauntlet, Teferi Master of Time, and The Chain Veil to generate infinite turns and lock out opponents.
Generate infinite card draw via Bolas's Citadel, Sensei's Divining Top, and Sheoldred the Apocalypse synergy to mill opponents out or deal near-infinite damage through Sheoldred's drain trigger.
Attack with creatures to trigger Raffine's connive ability, discarding cards into graveyard, then reanimate threats via graveyard payoffs and recursion.

Generate infinite mana via Power Artifact + Basalt/Grim Monolith or Auriok Salvagers + Lion's Eye Diamond, create infinite artifact ETB/death triggers with Sharuum copies, then win through Thassa's Oracle or exhausting resources.
Generate artifact tokens that enter and create cascading value via artifact ETB triggers, accumulate mana and resources, then win through artifact-based threats or locks.

Cast multicolor spells to grow Ramos with +1/+1 counters, accumulate mana via the counter sink ability, then cast game-winning spells or activate threats.
Deploy Dragons to attack, triggering The Ur-Dragon's draw and land-ramp engine, build board advantage, then win through Dragon combat damage.
Sacrifice and recur lands via The Gitrog Monster's production, trigger landfall payoffs repeatedly for card draw and mana, then win through overwhelming resources or creature threats.

Generate infinite creature tokens with haste via Dualcaster Mage copying spells like Twinflame, Heat Shimmer, or Molten Duplication, then win through sacrifice payoffs or poison counters.

Generate Meteorite tokens via Roxanne, create cascading mana and damage triggers, repeatedly attack to exponentially grow mana production, win through Treasure tokens and artifact payoffs or infinite combat.
Pump creatures with Xenagos's +X/+X ability and haste grant, dealing massive commander damage. Aggravated Assault combo provides infinite combat phases as an alternate line.
Attack with Dinosaurs, especially Gishath to fetch additional Dinosaurs from the library, leveraging landfall triggers and tribal synergies to overwhelm opponents.
Generate infinite card draw by casting reduced-cost historic spells and repeatedly activating Sensei's Divining Top loops through cost-reduction engines, drawing the deck to find a finisher.

Generate tokens via Cayth's fabricate and populate ability, sacrificing them with Ashnod's Altar to grow creatures exponentially via Cathars' Crusade, creating a self-reinforcing loop to overwhelm opponents.

Generate infinite card draw and storm through spell-based combo lines like Displacer Kitten + cheap artifacts, Frantic Search + recursion, or Underworld Breach loops, then finish with a storm payoff or damage effect.

Shut down opponent lifegain via Erebos while building a sacrifice engine around permanents dying. Generate card advantage and drain payoffs, winning through accumulated value and attrition.

Build a Wizard creature base and generate repeated card advantage via Azami's tap-to-draw ability. Control opponent threats while drawing cards; win through combat damage or attrition.
Lock down opponents' plays with counterspells and permission effects, then win through commander damage or accumulated card advantage.

Cast instants and sorceries to generate flying Drake tokens, then attack to deal commander damage.

Equip Sram with powerful equipment and auras, drawing cards and generating card advantage; close out the game with Sram's commander damage or overwhelming board presence.

Sacrifice creatures repeatedly to generate death triggers and drain payoffs; Elenda grows from deaths and creates tokens on death, feeding further sacrifice loops for exponential value.
Generate infinite lifegain triggers via Exquisite Blood or Aetherflux Reservoir with drain effects like Sanguine Bond or Vito; win through infinite life gain or life loss to opponents.
